description: Executes a user-supplied Python transform script stored in S3 against the input dataset. The script must define a function named transform(df) that accepts and returns a pandas DataFrame. Runs inside a RestrictedPython sandbox — network access, file I/O, subprocess, and class-hierarchy traversal are blocked at the AST level. Provides pd (pandas), np (numpy), scipy, and sklearn in the execution namespace. A configurable wall-clock timeout (default 120s, max 300s) is enforced. Intended for institution-specific transforms that do not fit a standard profile.

script_uri.description: S3 URI of the Python script to execute (s3://bucket/key.py). The script must define transform(df) -> pd.DataFrame.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds for script execution (default 120, max 300)

output_schema.note: Output shape depends entirely on the user-supplied transform script
